podcast.body: A hit song from Aretha Franklin's 1973 album *Hey Now Hey*, produced by Quincy Jones. This track achieved significant chart success, reaching number one on the R&B chart and making it into the Top 20 on the Pop chart. "Which spawned her number 1 R&B Top 20 Pop Hit Angel."
